question: A charged particle enters a region with uniform electric field $\vec{E} = E_0 \hat{k}$ and uniform magnetic field $\vec{B} = B_0 \hat{k}$ with an initial velocity $\vec{v} = v_0 \hat{i}$. Predict the nature of the particle's trajectory.

options.A: A helix with constant pitch along the z-axis.
options.B: A helix with increasing pitch along the z-axis.
options.C: A uniform circular path in the x-y plane.
options.D: A parabolic path in the x-z plane.
